note: Composition manifest for DRAFT TAPPs authored in this repository. Same shape as the TAPP library's composed_tapps.json, kept separate so an unreviewed draft never enters the library's own record of what exists. module_composition consults the library manifest first and falls back to this file, so a draft composes module $defs by $ref exactly as a released TAPP does.

composed.note: DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP. Seeded from the ADA VNMIR detail schema; source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library. Aggregation deliberately not composed: VNMIR reports per-measurement spectra, not values aggregated from multiple analyses - same module set as Lab-XCT.

DRAFT - not a Phase 0 reviewed TAPP. Seeded from the ADA QRIS detail schema; source lives in the geochemBuildingBlocks repo (draftTAPPs/), not this library.
